prompt.text:
Implement package `solution` using only the standard library.

Export:

```go
type OutputFormat int

const (
    FormatLines OutputFormat = iota
    FormatJSON
)

func RenderBindings(values map[string]string, format OutputFormat) (string, error)
```

Every key must be a valid identifier: its first character is an ASCII letter or underscore, and every remaining character is an ASCII letter, digit, or underscore. Any invalid key or unsupported format returns `""` and an error. Values may contain arbitrary UTF-8 strings. The input map must not be mutated.

Keys must always be emitted in ascending bytewise lexicographic order. `FormatLines` emits one line per binding as `key = <Go-quoted value>\n`, using `strconv.Quote` semantics. An empty map produces an empty string.

`FormatJSON` emits a compact JSON object followed by one newline. Both keys and values use valid JSON string quoting, with no spaces around separators. An empty map produces `{}\n`. Nil maps follow the same behavior as empty maps. Output must be deterministic across calls.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
